Gabriela Dezotti
Welcome to my personal website!
My name is Gabriela Dezotti (she/her) and I am currently a PhD candidate in the Ecology, Evolution and Biodiversity Programme at Universidade Estadual Paulista (UNESP) in Rio Claro, Brazil. I am a member of the BioMe Group being supervised by Professor Tadeu Siqueira.
I consider myself a work-in-progress vegetation ecologist with a strong interest in disturbances. Right now, I am exploring how novel disturbance regimes affect communities in an integrated framework considering different time, space and organizational scales. My work is usually focused on fire ecology, but I am also interested in other types of disturbances, such as droughts and floods. Besides my research, I am deeply interested in FAIR data management and open science practices.
You can find more about my research here. If you want to get in touch, please feel free to contact me anytime. ;)
